$comment: Manifest submitted to the codriver app marketplace. This repo doubles as the worked example: every field below is the real value that ships.
name: ntfy
description: Shows your phone's ntfy.sh notifications beside the map, newest first. Works with ntfy.sh or your own self-hosted server, and with protected topics.
install_instructions: Install ntfy on your phone (ntfy.sh) and pick a topic name that nobody could guess. In codriver.io/account -> Apps -> ntfy, enter the server (https://ntfy.sh unless you self-host) and that topic name. If the topic is protected, paste an access token from your ntfy account. Anything you publish to the topic appears in the widget within a second.

fields.label: ntfy server
fields.help: Use your own server's URL if you self-host.

fields.label: Topic
fields.help: The topic you publish to from your phone.
